newsitem.title: USA: CME May lumber sharply higher on strong cash tone.
newsitem.headline: CME May lumber sharply higher on strong cash tone.

text.p: CME May lumber futures were sharply higher at mid-morning, boosted by a strong tone to the cash market, floor traders said.
Buying was scattered and volume was light.
There were expectations that cash lumber prices will remain strong with mill order files out into late April, traders said.
Bull spreading added to the gain in the nearby, they said.

Analysts also noted many dealers and wholesales had kept stocks low in anticipation of a "wall of wood" coming from Canada at the start ot the new quota year on April 1, but product offerings remained light.
At 1200 CST May lumber was up $8.00 at $414.70 per thousand board feet.
